publication.publication: The native host dispatcher receives the captured event after the supplied source connection outer commit, or immediately when that connection has no active transaction.
publication.rollback: Callbacks attach to the matching native connection and current nesting record; native outer/savepoint rollback discards the corresponding callbacks.
publication.registration_failure: Missing source transaction records fail before commit; Mail Notifications reports and drops unusable observations.
publication.host_policy: Host after-commit listeners and queue after_commit policies can add their own deferral after publication. Host transaction infrastructure and dispatcher bindings are preserved.
publication.delivery_limit: Local callbacks are not an outbox. Process exit between commit and callback can lose delivery; no crash durability or exactly-once delivery is promised.
publication.cardinality: One canonical object is dispatched per qualifying producer call. This is local publication, not cross-process deduplication or a guarantee that repeated observations are unique.
publication.manual_producers: Use Nvl\Support\Events\DomainEventDispatcher::dispatch($event, $writerConnection). Native Event::dispatch() is immediate and has no package interception.
